{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "molecular_complexity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized composite of molecular size indicators V1 (log scale), V7 (branching), and V16 (ring count), capturing overall structural complexity as a smooth continuous score",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear SVM benefits from a single smooth composite that captures molecular complexity along a principal axis separating biodegradable from recalcitrant compounds",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((V1 - 2.0) / 4.496 * 0.4 + np.clip(V7 / 18.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.3 + np.clip(V16 / 40.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.3), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "lipophilicity_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximation of lipophilicity using V2 (hydrophobic descriptor) normalized by V1 (molecular size), reflecting tendency to partition into lipid phases which affects biodegradation",
      "value_range": [0.1, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "physicochemical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Lipophilicity is a key driver of biodegradation; this ratio provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with SVM margin optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V2 / np.maximum(V1, 0.5), 0.1, 2.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "heteroatom_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Density of heteroatoms (V3 nitrogen-like, V4 halogen-like, V6 oxygen-like counts) relative to molecular size V1, indicating functional group richness",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "functional_groups",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Heteroatom density captures chemical reactivity relevant to biodegradation pathways; normalized ratio is well-suited for linear decision boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((V3 + V4 * 2.0 + V6) / np.maximum(V1, 0.5), 0.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "electronic_charge_asymmetry",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of partial charge descriptor V12 from zero, scaled by V13 (electronegativity-related), capturing electronic polarization of the molecule",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "electronic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Electronic asymmetry affects enzyme recognition and biodegradation susceptibility; smooth continuous measure improves linear SVM separability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.abs(V12) / np.maximum(V13, 0.5), 0.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "topological_branching_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite branching measure combining V7 (branching count), V9 (connectivity), and V10 (path length), normalized to unit scale for linear projection",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "topological",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Branching topology strongly influences biodegradation; this normalized index provides a smooth feature for SVM hyperplane alignment",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.clip(V7 / 18.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.4 + np.clip(V9 / 24.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.3 + np.clip(V10 / 12.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.3), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_surface_estimate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Estimate of molecular surface area using V8 (surface-related descriptor) normalized by training mean and std, providing a z-score-like continuous feature",
      "value_range": [-4.5, 2.6],
      "feature_family": "physicochemical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Molecular surface area affects aqueous solubility and microbial accessibility; z-score normalization is ideal for SVM margin computation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V8 - 37.056) / 9.140"
    },
    {
      "name": "ring_system_complexity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed count of ring-related features V16 and V33, capturing aromatic and aliphatic ring contributions to structural rigidity",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.8],
      "feature_family": "structural_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ring systems reduce biodegradation rates; log transformation compresses the heavy tail for better linear separability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V16 + V33)"
    },
    {
      "name": "polarity_balance_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of polar descriptor V14 to nonpolar size V15, capturing the hydrophilic-hydrophobic balance relevant to aqueous biodegradation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.1],
      "feature_family": "physicochemical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Polarity balance is a key physicochemical driver; this ratio provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with linear decision boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V14 / np.maximum(V15, 1.0), 0.0, 1.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "connectivity_index_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized version of V27 (Wiener-type connectivity index), a key topological descriptor for molecular graph structure",
      "value_range": [-5.4, 2.8],
      "feature_family": "topological",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Connectivity indices are strong predictors of biodegradation; z-score normalization directly supports SVM margin optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V27 - 2.2156) / 0.2260"
    },
    {
      "name": "fragment_diversity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of diverse fragment indicators V20, V21, V24, V25, V26, V29 capturing presence of rare functional groups that affect biodegradation pathways",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "functional_groups",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Rare functional fragments often indicate recalcitrant structures; this weighted composite provides a smooth severity score for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V20 * 0.8 + V21 * 1.2 + V24 * 1.5 + V25 * 0.6 + V26 * 0.9 + V29 * 1.0, 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_adjusted_polarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between molecular size V1 and electronic descriptor V12, capturing how charge distribution scales with molecular size",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "electronic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Size-polarity interaction captures nonlinear structure-activity relationships in a single linear feature, improving SVM margin quality",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((V1 - 4.783) * V12, -15.0, 15.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "biodegradation_structural_risk",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of structural features associated with biodegradation difficulty: high values indicate molecules with large ring systems (V16 > 6), high halogen content (V4 > 0), low polarity (V14 < 0.5), and high molecular complexity (V1 > 5), all of which are known to reduce biodegradability. Score ranges from 0 (easily biodegradable structural profile) to 4 (highly recalcitrant structural profile).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "domain_knowledge",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain expertise about structural recalcitrance into a single ordinal score, providing a strong linear feature for SVM classification",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
